cards.front: A value is given in kg in a Mechanics problem. Which quantity is it measuring?
cards.back: Mass.

cards.front: What SI unit is used for force in Mechanics?
cards.back: The newton, N.

cards.front: Distance is a [ ___ ], while displacement is a [ ___ ].
cards.back: Distance is a scalar, while displacement is a vector.

cards.front: An object moves forwards then backwards. For displacement, why should you not just add the path lengths?
cards.back: Displacement uses net change in position with direction.

cards.front: Speed is the rate of change of [ ___ ]; velocity is the rate of change of [ ___ ].
cards.back: Speed is the rate of change of distance; velocity is the rate of change of displacement.

cards.front: If east is chosen as positive, what sign should westward velocity have?
cards.back: Negative.

cards.front: A cyclist travels 80 m east then 30 m west. What is the distance travelled?
A cyclist travels 80 m east then 30 m west. What is the displacement?
cards.back: 50 m east.

cards.front: The 80 m east, 30 m west journey takes 25 s. What is the average speed?
The 80 m east, 30 m west journey takes 25 s. What is the average velocity?
cards.back: 2 m s-1 east.

cards.front: Velocity has SI unit [ ___ ]; acceleration has SI unit [ ___ ].
cards.back: Velocity has SI unit m s-1; acceleration has SI unit m s-2.

cards.front: Why is acceleration measured in m s-2 rather than m s-1?
cards.back: It is change in velocity per second.

cards.front: One newton is equivalent to [ ___ ].
cards.back: One newton is equivalent to 1 kg m s-2.

cards.front: A distance of 1 km is [ ___ ]; a time of 1 minute is [ ___ ].
cards.back: A distance of 1 km is 1000 m; a time of 1 minute is 60 seconds.

cards.front: A length of 1 cm is [ ___ ]; a time of 1 hour is [ ___ ].
cards.back: A length of 1 cm is 0.01 m; a time of 1 hour is 3600 seconds.

cards.front: How do you convert a speed from km h-1 to m s-1?
cards.back: Multiply by 5/18.

cards.front: A runner covers 1.5 km in 5 minutes. What is the average speed in m s-1?
In constant acceleration, acceleration stays [ ___ ] throughout the motion.
cards.back: In constant acceleration, acceleration stays the same throughout the motion.

cards.front: The symbol s often means [ ___ ], but the unit symbol s means [ ___ ].
cards.back: The symbol s often means displacement, but the unit symbol s means seconds.

cards.front: Why can at be added to u in v = u + at?
cards.back: at has units m s-1, same as velocity.

cards.front: Initial velocity is 4 m s-1, acceleration is 1.5 m s-2, time is 8 s. What is final velocity?
In s = ut + ½at2, what units must both right-hand terms have?
cards.back: Metres.
